title: EpiNarrate：基于智能体的流行病学情景叙事生成框架
summary: 提出EpiNarrate智能体框架，将结构化数值推理与自然语言生成分离，通过偏序模式提取、比较语法约束和最大熵有趣性选择机制，从流行病学情景投影中生成事实准确、覆盖全面的公共健康叙事报告。在COVID-19情景建模中心数据上验证，相比直接使用LLM，显著提升了事实准确性和关键模式覆盖率。
summary_en: Introduces EpiNarrate, an agentic framework that separates structured numerical reasoning from NLG to generate factually grounded public health narratives from epidemiological projections. It uses partial-order schema, comparison grammar, and maximum-entropy selection to improve accuracy and coverage over direct LLM use, validated on COVID-19 Scenario Modeling Hub data.
